# ArenaRPG

This repository is built for learning software architecture.

The priority is maintainability over implementation speed.

Architecture comes before code.

Documentation comes before implementation.

Never propose implementations before understanding the problem.

The Gameplay layer must not depend on UI.

The Core Engine must be reusable.

The project intentionally avoids overengineering.

Always keep modules small and cohesive.

Every system should have a single responsibility.

Whenever a new module appears ask whether documentation already exists.

Prefer composition over inheritance.

Avoid global state.

Avoid Service Locator.

Avoid Singleton unless there is a very strong reason.

Do not create abstractions without a demonstrated need.

Favor readability over cleverness.
